userStories.title: Create savings-related database tables and TypeScript types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need database tables for savings accounts, auto-allocation rules, and transfer history, plus TypeScript interfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Create migration file in supabase/migrations/ with savings_accounts table: id (UUID PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()), user_id (UUID FK to auth.users NOT NULL), name (TEXT NOT NULL), balance (NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()), sort_order (INTEGER DEFAULT 0)

Create savings_auto_rules table: id (UUID PK), user_id (UUID FK), savings_account_id (UUID FK to savings_accounts ON DELETE CASCADE), percentage (NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL CHECK between 0 and 100), is_active (BOOLEAN DEFAULT true), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW())

Create savings_transfers table: id (UUID PK), user_id (UUID FK), from_account_id (UUID nullable FK to savings_accounts), to_account_id (UUID nullable FK to savings_accounts), amount (NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK > 0), note (TEXT), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW())
Add RLS policies on all three tables: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
Add indexes on user_id for all tables, and on savings_account_id for savings_auto_rules
Add TypeScript interfaces (SavingsAccount, SavingsAutoRule, SavingsTransfer) to src/types/database.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Migration: 20260206000001_create_savings_accounts.sql. Types: SavingsAccount, SavingsAutoRule, SavingsTransfer added to database.ts.

userStories.title: Create investment-related database tables and TypeScript types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need database tables for investment accounts, asset buy/sell transactions, and a price cache.
acceptanceCriteria: Create migration file with investment_accounts table: id (UUID PK), user_id (UUID FK NOT NULL), name (TEXT NOT NULL), cash_balance (NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()), sort_order (INTEGER DEFAULT 0)

Create investment_transactions table: id (UUID PK), user_id (UUID FK), investment_account_id (UUID FK to investment_accounts ON DELETE CASCADE), asset_symbol (TEXT NOT NULL), asset_name (TEXT NOT NULL), asset_type (TEXT NOT NULL CHECK IN ('stock','etf','crypto','commodity','bond')), transaction_type (TEXT NOT NULL CHECK IN ('buy','sell')), quantity (NUMERIC(18,8) NOT NULL CHECK > 0), price_per_unit (NUMERIC(18,8) NOT NULL CHECK > 0), total_amount (NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK > 0), currency (TEXT DEFAULT 'EUR'), transaction_date (DATE NOT NULL), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW())

Create asset_prices_cache table: id (UUID PK), symbol (TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL), asset_type (TEXT NOT NULL), current_price (NUMERIC(18,8)), price_currency (TEXT DEFAULT 'USD'), last_updated (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW())
Add RLS policies on investment_accounts and investment_transactions (user_id = auth.uid()). asset_prices_cache is readable by all authenticated users
Add indexes on user_id and investment_account_id
Add TypeScript interfaces (InvestmentAccount, InvestmentTransaction, AssetPriceCache) to src/types/database.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Migration: 20260206000002_create_investment_accounts.sql. Types: InvestmentAccount, InvestmentTransaction, AssetPriceCache added to database.ts.

userStories.title: Create unallocated balances table and recalculation utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to track unallocated savings and investment amounts per user, synced from the monthly tracker.
acceptanceCriteria: Create migration with unallocated_balances table: id (UUID PK), user_id (UUID FK UNIQUE), savings_unallocated (NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0), investments_unallocated (NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0), last_auto_applied (TIMESTAMPTZ nullable), updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW())
Add RLS policy: user_id = auth.uid()
Create src/lib/wealth-accounts.ts with recalculateUnallocated(userId) function
Function queries all months' transactions via Supabase to compute total savings and total investments amounts using the same logic as calculateMonthlySummary()
Savings unallocated = total cumulative savings - sum of all savings_accounts.balance
Investments unallocated = total cumulative investments - sum of all investment_accounts.cash_balance - sum of all buy transaction amounts + sum of all sell transaction amounts
Upserts result to unallocated_balances with onConflict user_id
Add TypeScript interface UnallocatedBalance to src/types/database.ts
Write unit tests for the recalculation logic with mock data
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Migration: 20260206000003_create_unallocated_balances.sql. Type: UnallocatedBalance in database.ts. Pure calc: wealth-calculations.ts computeUnallocated(). DB wrapper: wealth-accounts.ts recalculateUnallocated(). Tests: 8/8 pass. Updated vitest 1.6->3.2.4 for Node v24 compat.
